title: Closeout summary: Search integrity and backend parity hardening
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented versioned content-bound FTS schema and full integrity checks; backend-aware explain and JSON validation; FTS/JSON field/type/multi-term/snippet parity; normalized global ranking; read-only and symlink safety; coordinated retrying rebuilds; best-effort cache updates; visible dashboard failures; current daemon/help/docs paths; and regression coverage.

Close reason: All search integrity and backend parity acceptance criteria are implemented and verified; strict closeout's sole blocker is unrelated raw-source reconciliation.
